name: CHIKV-Nb1
design_rationale: CDR1 aromatic residues (F,Y) for pi-stacking with epitope His/Tyr. CDR2 polar residues (S,T) for H-bonding. CDR3 contains Cys for potential disulfide stabilization and mixed charged/hydrophobic residues for broad interaction.

name: CHIKV-Nb2
design_rationale: CDR1 acidic (D) for salt bridges with basic epitope residues. CDR2 flexible Gly-rich loop. CDR3 Arg-rich for strong electrostatic interactions with acidic epitope patches.

name: CHIKV-Nb3
design_rationale: CDR1 hydrophobic (I,F) for beta-sheet complementarity. CDR2 Thr for H-bonding. CDR3 combines Arg for electrostatics and Tyr for aromatic interactions.
